title: 第15章 审问异端第16章 暂歇
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
夜色笼罩下，这座盛产水晶而得名的城市中，两道身影飞快的穿梭而过
特莫斯与杰尔没有去管被人看到样貌这种事，仿佛身后有什么恶魔即将追上他们
“混蛋！这家伙居然敢在没有证据的情况下审问抓捕一个伯爵，这帮异端审判官根本就不是人！”
特莫斯抓着自己断掉的手指怒骂着：“他真的受了重伤？！那种力量和速度，我再弱一点就被一脚踢死了！”
依靠风系魔法快速移动的杰尔也是心有余悸：“他重伤肯定是真的，情报可靠但不全面，【先知】估计也没预料到，高级审判官就算重伤也能有这么恐怖的力量”
“没受伤的高级审判官到底有多强啊”
特莫斯啐了一口，转头看向杰尔喊道：
“还有你！不是成天说魔法师要比其他职业更强吗？怎么连拖住他做不到？”
闻言，杰尔的脸色微微一变，气急败坏的怒骂：
“你以为是我不想吗？！听清楚了！！那家伙也是个魔法师！！而且绝对比我强！！！”
“哈？！”
特莫斯露出了不可思议的表情，又看了看自己被斩断的手指，脚步都停了一瞬，满脸不可置信
“你确定他是魔法师？！他差点一脚把我踢死！那是魔法师该有的样子？！”
“我确定！”
杰尔长舒了一口气，似乎是感到有些后怕：
“我的魔力被压制了，只有高阶魔法师才能做到这种事。哪怕是他现在重伤后的实力，都至少是五级魔法师！那就是个怪物！！！”
闻言，特莫斯也是不由得张大了嘴，他知道魔法师的等级，也清楚五级魔法师意味着什么
魔法师与其他职业一样都由低到高分为一到九级，但相对其他职业，有资格成为魔法师的人少了太多，也因此导致魔法师的数量极少
魔法师本身的强大与稀有，让他们成为了被各个势力偏爱的群体
杰尔虽然只是个三级魔法师，但他的魔法与魔器却可以让他正面抗衡五级的骑士，也让他成为了幻神教会的管理者之一

这么说吧，除了杰尔以外，水晶城这种小城市里只有魔法协会分会的会长是三级魔法师。
而如今莫森帝国唯一的宫廷魔法师，则是一名八级的高阶大魔法师
听着杰尔的声音，特莫斯不免露出了质疑的表情：
“你确定你没判断错？五级魔法师也扯了”
杰尔一股怒火涌起，忍不住大喊：“你爱信不信，我说了他绝对是个魔.......”
杰尔的话没能说完，而特莫斯也是停下了脚步，愣愣的看着前方
冷汗止不住的从二人身上冒出，特莫斯与杰尔呆滞看着眼前的景象
整整七道足够笼罩半个水晶城的魔法阵交错重叠，死死的锁定了他们
每一道魔法阵，都远超杰尔刚刚释放的魔法，无论是精细度还是威力
杰尔很确定，这七道魔法阵一但落下来，水晶城不会受到一点影响，但他们两个绝对连渣都不剩
content_en:
Under the cover of night, in this city named after its rich production of crystals, two figures quickly shuttled past
Temos and Jer didn't care about being seen, as if there was some demon behind them that was about to catch up with them.
"Asshole! This guy actually dares to interrogate and arrest a count without evidence. These heretical inquisitors are not human at all!"
Temos grabbed his broken finger and cursed angrily: "Is he really seriously injured?! With that kind of strength and speed, if I had been any weaker, I would have been kicked to death!"
Jer, who relies on wind magic to move quickly, is also frightened: "It is definitely true that he is seriously injured. The information is reliable but not comprehensive. The [Prophet] probably did not expect that a senior judge can have such terrifying power even if he is seriously injured."
"How strong is the uninjured Senior Inquisitor?"
Temos spat, turned to look at Jer and shouted:
"And you! Don't you always say that magicians are stronger than other professions? Why can't you even hold him back?"
Hearing this, Jier's face changed slightly, and he cursed angrily:
"Do you think I don't want to?! Listen clearly!! That guy is also a magician!! And he is definitely better than me!!!"
"Huh?!"
Temos showed an incredible expression and looked at his severed finger again. He stopped for a moment, his face full of disbelief.
"Are you sure he is a magician?! He almost kicked me to death! Is that what a magician should look like?!"
"I'm sure!"
Jie Er breathed a long sigh of relief, seeming to feel a little scared:
"My magic power has been suppressed. Only high-level magicians can do this. Even with his current strength after being seriously injured, he is at least a fifth-level magician! That's a monster!!!"
Hearing this, Temos couldn't help but open his mouth. He knew the level of a magician and what a fifth-level magician meant.
Like other professions, magicians are divided into levels one to nine from low to high. However, compared to other professions, there are far fewer people who are qualified to become magicians, which results in a very small number of magicians.
The power and rarity of magicians themselves make them a group favored by various forces.
Although Jer is only a third-level magician, his magic and magic weapons can allow him to compete head-on with fifth-level knights, and he has also become one of the managers of the Illusory God Church.
Let's put it this way, except for Gyor, only the president of the Magic Association branch in a small city like Crystal City is a third-level magician.
And now the only court magician in the Mawson Empire is an eighth-level high-level magician.
Listening to Jer's voice, Temos could not help but show a questioning expression:
"Are you sure you're not wrong? Even a fifth-level magician is lying."
Jer's anger surged and he couldn't help shouting: "Believe it or not, I said he is definitely a devil..."
Jer couldn't finish what he said, and Temos also stopped and stared blankly ahead.
Cold sweat couldn't stop breaking out from the two of them. Temos and Jer looked blankly at the scene in front of them.
A total of seven magic circles, enough to cover half of the Crystal City, overlapped and locked onto them.
Every magic circle far exceeds the magic Jel just released, both in terms of precision and power.
Jer is very sure that once these seven magic circles fall, Crystal City will not be affected at all, but the two of them will definitely not have any scum left.
